terbaru.pelajaran: Closed subgroups of the group of isometries of the regular tree $\treeq$ that fix an end of the tree and are vertex-transitive are shown to correspond, on one hand, to self-replicating groups acting on rooted trees and, on the other hand, to elements of totally disconnected, locally compact groups having positive scale.

terbaru.judul: On the simplicity of Nekrashevych algebras of contracting self-similar groups
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper we give necessary and sufficient conditions for the Nekrashevych algebra of a contracting group to be simple.

terbaru.judul: The Program with a Personality: Analysis of Elk Cloner, the First Personal Computer Virus
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we: present the first detailed examination of the operation and structure of Elk Cloner; discuss the effect of environmental characteristics on its virulence; and provide supporting evidence for several hypotheses about why its release was largely ignored in the early 1980s.

terbaru.judul: Microphase separation in active filament systems is maintained by cyclic dynamics of cluster size and order
terbaru.pelajaran: Here we show that emergence and maintenance of polar order are governed by the interplay between the assembly and disassembly dynamics of clusters with varying size and degree of polar order.

terbaru.judul: On the self-replicating properties of Riemann zeta zeros: A statistical study
terbaru.pelajaran: We study distributions of differences of unscaled Riemann zeta zeros, $γ-γ^{'}$, at large distances.

terbaru.judul: Analysis of Compression Techniques for DNA Sequence Data
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we have explored diverse types of techniques for compression of large amounts of DNA Sequence Data.

terbaru.judul: Near-Term Self-replicating Probes -- A Concept Design
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we propose a concept for a partially self-replicating probe for space exploration based on current and near-term technologies, with a focus on small spacecraft.

terbaru.judul: Traveling fronts in self-replicating persistent random walks with multiple internal states
terbaru.pelajaran: Self-activation coupled to a transport mechanism results in traveling waves that describe polymerization reactions, forest fires, tumor growth, and even the spread of epidemics.
